pages.text:
Syntax: quest <command> [argument]
              |
              |The quest system lets you earn quest points by completing tasks assigned by
              |a questmaster mob, then spend those points on special rewards.
              |
              |Available commands:
              |
              |  {Yquest points{x            Show quest points AND charges
              |  {Yquest info{x              Show details of your current quest
              |  {Yquest time{x              Show time remaining on your current quest
              |  {Yquest request{x           Spend a quest charge to start a new quest
              |  {Yquest complete{x          Report a completed quest to the questmaster
              |  {Yquest list{x              List available rewards and their costs
              |  {Yquest buy{x <item>        Spend quest points on a reward
              |
              |All quest commands (except POINTS, INFO, and TIME) require you to be in the
              |same room as a questmaster NPC.
              |
              |See also: QUEST REQUEST, QUEST COMPLETE, QUEST LIST, QUEST BUY, QUEST POINTS,
              |          QUEST HEIRLOOM, QUEST CHANCES
              |

Syntax: quest points
              |
              |Displays two resources:
              |
              |  {YQuest Points{x    Accumulated currency for buying rewards (QUEST BUY).
              |  {YQuest Charges{x   Charges you must spend before the questmaster will
              |                   assign you a new quest (QUEST REQUEST).
              |
              |Charges are earned automatically as you gain experience — roughly one
              |charge per 5%% of a level's worth of XP. They accumulate without limit
              |and roll over across levels.
              |
              |See also: QUEST, QUEST BUY, QUEST CHANCES
              |

Syntax: quest info
              |
              |Displays the details of your active quest, including whether you are hunting
              |a mob or recovering an object. If your quest is complete and you need to
              |return to the questmaster, this command will remind you.
              |
              |See also: QUEST, QUEST TIME
              |

Syntax: quest time
              |
              |Shows the time remaining on your current quest. Each quest has a countdown of
              |10-30 minutes. If you do not complete and report the quest before time runs
              |out, you will not receive a reward and must wait before being given another
              |quest.
              |
              |If you are not on a quest, shows how many minutes remain before you may
              |request another one (normally 10 minutes between quests).
              |
              |See also: QUEST, QUEST INFO
              |

Syntax: quest request
              |
              |Asks the questmaster in your current room to assign you a quest. You must not
              |already be on a quest or in the cooldown period between quests.
              |
              |{YRequirement:{x  You need at least one quest charge to request a quest.
              |Charges are earned automatically from XP (see QUEST CHANCES). The questmaster
              |will show your current progress if you do not have a charge ready.
              |
              |You will be sent on one of two types of quest:
              |
              |  {YSlay quest{x   Find and kill a specific NPC somewhere in the world.
              |  {YItem quest{x   Recover a stolen item and return it to the questmaster.
              |
              |The questmaster will tell you the name of the target and the general area
              |where it can be found. You then have 10-30 minutes to complete the task.
              |
              |See also: QUEST, QUEST COMPLETE, QUEST INFO, QUEST TIME, QUEST CHANCES
              |

Syntax: quest complete
              |
              |Reports a finished quest to the questmaster who assigned it. You must return
              |to the same questmaster who sent you on the quest.
              |
              |  {YSlay quest{x   You must have killed the target mob before reporting.
              |  {YItem quest{x   You must be carrying the quest item when you report.
              |
              |On success you receive a gold reward (2500-45000 coins), quest points
              |(25-75), and a 15% chance of 1-6 bonus practice sessions. A 10-minute
              |cooldown then applies before you can request another quest.
              |
              |See also: QUEST, QUEST REQUEST
              |

Syntax: quest list
              |
              |Displays all rewards currently available for purchase from the questmaster,
              |along with their quest point costs. Use QUEST BUY to purchase an item.
              |
              |Rewards are defined in json/config/quest_rewards.json and can be updated
              |without recompiling.
              |
              |See also: QUEST, QUEST BUY, QUEST POINTS
              |

Syntax: quest buy <item>
              |
              |Spends quest points to purchase a reward from the questmaster. The <item>
              |argument matches any alias listed for the reward (see QUEST LIST).
              |
              |Reward types:
              |
              |  {Yobject{x      Creates an item and places it in your inventory.
              |  {Ygold{x        Transfers gold coins directly to you.
              |  {Ypractices{x   Adds practice sessions to your total.
              |
              |{YHeirloom items{x (those marked with the REWARD flag) are scaled to your
              |current level at the moment you buy them, and will re-scale automatically
              |every time you gain a level. See QUEST HEIRLOOM for details.
              |
              |If the requested object cannot be created (e.g. missing vnum), your quest
              |points are refunded automatically.
              |
              |See also: QUEST, QUEST LIST, QUEST POINTS, QUEST HEIRLOOM
              |

pages.keyword: QUEST HEIRLOOM NOQUEST HEIRLOOM QUEST REWARD NOQUEST REWARD
pages.text:
Quest heirlooms are special items purchased from a questmaster (QUEST BUY)
              |that grow with your character instead of becoming obsolete.
              |
              |{YScaling:{x  When you buy a heirloom it is created at your current level.
              |The stat bonuses are scaled proportionally — roughly 25%% of maximum power
              |at level 1, growing linearly to 100%% at level 45, then a small bonus above
              |level 45. Each time you gain a level, every worn heirloom you have equipped
              |is automatically re-scaled to your new level.
              |
              |{YVariance:{x  Above level 10 each scale roll introduces a small random
              |adjustment (+1 or -1) on each stat, so identical items may differ slightly.
              |
              |{YMaintenance:{x  Because heirlooms scale on level-up they work best when
              |kept equipped. Unequipped heirlooms in your inventory are NOT re-scaled
              |until you equip them and level again (or sell and re-buy them).
              |
              |{YNoPurge:{x  Heirlooms will not be deleted when the world resets.
              |
              |See also: QUEST, QUEST BUY, QUEST LIST
              |

Quest charges (also called quest chances) are a second resource tracked by
              |the quest system alongside quest points.
              |
              |{YHow charges are earned:{x
              |  Automatically as you gain experience. Roughly one charge is awarded per
              |  5%% of a level's worth of XP earned. Charges accumulate across levels with
              |  no maximum.
              |
              |{YHow charges are spent:{x
              |  One charge is consumed each time you successfully request a quest from a
              |  questmaster (QUEST REQUEST). The questmaster will refuse to assign a quest
              |  if you have zero charges, and will show your progress toward the next one.
              |
              |{YChecking your charges:{x
              |  Use QUEST POINTS or SCORE to see how many charges you currently have and
              |  how much XP progress you have toward the next one.
              |
              |See also: QUEST, QUEST POINTS, QUEST REQUEST, SCORE
              |
